elements.text: Three layouts: Readout, Menu + Detail, Launch. Content sits between the rail and the bottom corners and scrolls inside its frame, never the page.
Menu + Detail — Work, Projects, Open Source
no content frames — the sky, the ship, one button

Width: frames are min(100% − 2 × edge, 540); the 760 pair only from desktop (≥ 1024).

Menu + Detail below 1024: one Frame, the selected row opens in place (body, chips, links); one open at a time, the rest stay listed. The leader line isn't drawn — the open row is the link.

Top: below the rail, max(8vh, 72px) for Menu + Detail, max(14vh, 72px) for Readout. Bottom: content stops above the info readout and orb (max-height calc(100dvh − top − 180px); phone − 140px) and scrolls inside its Frame.

Skills (Readout): the education Entry, a 1px rule, then the four skill Readouts in 2 columns (1 below 600).

Launch: nothing in the middle; the info readout and LAUNCH SHIP are the content.

flip-card deck row (h-32 md:h-40) · the unused md:grid-cols-3 deck grid · max-h-[50vh] deck scroll on phones · the page-level text-center headings in cyan · layout modes "large-panel / small-panel-with-deck / no-panel" → readout / menu-detail / launch.

knowledge.text: Layout.tsx: modes large-panel (paddingTop 14vh), small-panel-with-deck (8vh + flip deck row h-32 md:h-40 + detail), no-panel; every frame w-[min(92vw,540px)]; deck grid md:grid-cols-3 unused (every deck is tabs or one card); phone deck max-h-[50vh] scroll.
Three layouts: Readout (About, Skills), Menu + Detail (Work, Projects, Open Source), Launch (Play).
Menu + Detail on desktop: intro 540 on top, then menu 280 + 20 + detail 460 = 760 side by side with the gold leader.
knowledge.why: Room for body, chips and links in the detail; the leader reads left to right.

knowledge.text: Below 1024 the selected row opens in place under itself (accordion, one open), the others stay listed; no leader line.
knowledge.why: Nothing jumps away on a small screen; one scroll inside the Frame.

agent.brief: Layout.tsx picks one of three layouts per section from SECTIONS (add a `layout` field). Frames, Menu list, Leader from Containers; Entry renderers from Content.
rules: SECTIONS gets layout: about readout · work menu-detail · skills readout · projects menu-detail · osc menu-detail · play launch. getLayoutMode → this field; "large-panel" → readout, "small-panel-with-deck" → menu-detail, "no-panel" → launch.

Container: `fixed inset-0 z-20 pointer-events-none grid justify-items-center content-start px-4 tablet:px-6` with paddingTop `max(14vh,72px)` (readout) or `max(8vh,72px)` (menu-detail); children pointer-events-auto.

Readout: one Frame `w-full max-w-panel` (540) with `max-h-[calc(100dvh-var(--top)-140px)] desktop:max-h-[calc(100dvh-var(--top)-180px)] overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain`. Skills: Education Entry, a 1px border-line rule, then `grid grid-cols-1 tablet:grid-cols-2 gap-4` of Readouts.

Menu + Detail, desktop (≥1024): intro Frame max-w-panel; then `grid grid-cols-[280px_460px] gap-5` (760) — Menu list Frame left, Detail Frame (alive) right; a gold Leader from the selected row to the Detail. Both frames share the max-height rule and scroll inside.

Menu + Detail, below desktop: intro Frame, then ONE Frame (max-w-panel) holding the Menu list; the selected row renders its EntryDetail (body, chips, links) under itself, animated height over DUR.enter (calm: instant); one open at a time; no Leader. Tapping the open row keeps it open (it's a tab, aria-selected).
Launch: no content frames; the info readout shows title + Button action lg LAUNCH SHIP (InfoBar).
Delete: the flip deck row (Layout.tsx:141-160), the md:grid-cols-3 deck grid (:169), max-h-[50vh] deck scroll, the centered cyan h2 heading (:125; the title now comes from the Frame header).
